# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr. Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040)</sub>; Teddy Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

He continuously twirls his mustache while casting romantic glances toward Sukey Pullen.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

He is prone to overbearing, sarcastic, and strict discipline, often singling out specific pupils for harsh penalties. However, he also demonstrates a lenient side toward favored students and can be deeply emotional during public recitations or farewells.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c19 P32](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0032), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## Traits

- sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
- overbearing  <sub>[v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083)</sub>
- lenient with favorites  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P32](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0032)</sub>

## Abilities

- delivering deeply moving public recitations  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>
- composing poetry  <sub>[v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068)</sub>

## Goals

- to court and win the affections of Sukey Pullen  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>
- to prepare older students for the Regent's Academy entrance exam  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

During his tenure as the schoolmaster at Brierley school, Mr. Pidgeon focused much of his attention on preparing older students for entrance exams while spending considerable time courting Sukey Pullen. He administered harsh punishments to students, forcing Nell Harcourt to stand on the dais after she broke a slate over Hugh Carrow's head, and later making her sit next to Hugh as a penalty for being late. His uneven discipline led to complaints, including an incident where Sam Gammon's father confronted him after Sam was caned. At a local concert, he delivered Mark Antony's address while looking toward Sukey. At the conclusion of the school term in June, he delivered an emotional parting speech with tears in his eyes before relinquishing his position, which was later taken by Miss Thorne.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Lodged at the home of Eben Duckett while teaching in Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
- Secured his position at Brierley school because his uncle served as a controlling trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
